budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Maintain a passable relay gate, retrieve the physical core from the turret bay, and bring it to the extraction cell (1,4) with positive hull and at least one surviving squad member.
task.natural_termination: Extraction with positive core hull and a living squad member succeeds. Zero core hull or no living squad member fails. Otherwise truncate at 160. Natural completion has priority at the horizon; terminal raw state is absorbing.
task.interaction: Two spatial relay charge buffers control a shared choke point. A carrier sacrifices weapons and support abilities. Scout marking changes allies actual bolt damage, engineer jamming changes future firing opportunity, bulwark fields/guard absorb incoming bolts, and all abilities compete for a finite shared support pool.
task.observation_access: Terrain, gate, relays, supply, extraction and the core radio beacon are public. Each role sees its own state and entities within Manhattan radius five; a scout mark broadcasts the marked turret state to every role for eight turns. Invisible local rows are zero and carry an explicit visibility bit. Radius sensing does not model wall occlusion. Renderer uses the same entity masks; no full-state tactical information belongs in a role view.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Squad member actually allocated a new moving bolt and consumed ammunition
Squad member actually spent shared support on shield, scan or jam
Squad member replenished a nearby physical relay
Squad member physically picked up the dropped core
Squad member voluntarily dropped the carried core
Squad member consumed a finite supply unit at the base
Squad member lost actual health to an unblocked incoming bolt
Turret lost actual armor to a vulnerable impact
Turret launched an actual moving bolt
Pre-existing bolt slot was absorbed by a shield or guard this step; a reused slot is not its impact location
Core has been picked up at least once
Previously picked core has crossed left of the relay gate
Core extracted at the exit with positive hull and a surviving squad member

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
